reason: The ingredient list is honestly what I look for, but I buy my drinks at petrol stations between jobs and on Rohlík, and this is only on its own e-shop and in cafés I never sit in. At 55 CZK a can I'm not ordering a box from a brand I've never heard of just to try it.
objection: The label is in English, so I'm not sure it's even a Czech product or who actually makes it, and I can't grab it where I actually stop during the day.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the bio section on Rohlík or in a petrol station fridge with a Czech label and the producer's details, so I could try one can without ordering a whole pack.
